story_fr: Coca-Cola affiche une croissance organique de 10 % au T1 2026, portee par +8 % en ventes concentrees et +2 % en prix-mix, avec un chiffre d'affaires total en hausse de 12 % a 12,5 Mds $.
story_en: Coca-Cola posted 10% organic revenue growth in Q1 2026, driven by 8% in concentrate sales and 2% in price mix, with total net revenues up 12% to $12.5 billion.
quote: organic revenues (non-GAAP) grew 10%, driven by an 8% increase in concentrate sales and 2% growth in price mix

story_fr: La marge operationnelle atteint 35,0 % au T1 2026 contre 32,9 % un an plus tot, portee par la croissance organique et la maitrise des charges.
story_en: Operating margin reached 35.0% in Q1 2026 vs 32.9% a year ago, driven by organic growth and cost discipline.
quote: Operating margin was 35.0% versus 32.9% in the Prior Year

story_fr: Les volumes de boissons progressent de 3 % globalement au T1 2026, signe d'un retour a la croissance apres plusieurs trimestres sous pression inflationniste.
story_en: Global unit case volume grew 3% in Q1 2026, signaling a return to volume growth after several quarters of inflationary pressure.

story_fr: Coca-Cola Zero Sugar enregistre une quatrieme hausse consecutive a deux chiffres, avec des gains en single-serve aux Philippines et une nouvelle reference premium au Royaume-Uni.
story_en: Coca-Cola Zero Sugar achieved double-digit volume growth for the fourth consecutive quarter, with single-serve gains in the Philippines and a new premium SKU in the UK.
signal: Zero Sugar: 4e trim. consecutif a deux chiffres
quote: Coca-Cola Zero Sugar achieved double-digit volume growth for the fourth consecutive quarter

story_fr: La campagne Share a Coke revient a grande echelle avec 10 milliards de contenants personnalises distribues dans 120 pays et plus de 30 000 prenoms adaptes localement.
story_en: Share a Coke relaunched globally with approximately 10 billion personalized bottles and cans in 120+ countries and over 30,000 locally tailored names.
signal: Share a Coke: 10 Mds de contenants, 120 pays
quote: approximately 10 billion bottles and cans in more than 120 countries with over 30,000 names tailored to local markets

story_fr: Les mini-canettes accelerent en Amerique du Nord avec des volumes en hausse a un chiffre eleve apres leur deploiement en epiceries de proximite.
story_en: Mini-can volume grew high single digits in North America following the launch of single-serve mini cans in convenience retail stores.
